summary: This video is a giveaway announcement for Dragonheir players offering Heliolite Dice and Wyrmarrow. To enter the YouTube giveaway, viewers need to subscribe, like, and comment with their favorite Epic hero team. Additional giveaways and rewards are available on the creator's Discord server. The creator also notes that an Analysis Banner will arrive on November 8th.
